# ColumnPredicate

<link-summary>Decides whether a column is one to act on.</link-summary>

<web-summary>ColumnPredicate — Decides whether a column is one to act on. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>appsscript/sheet</code> · Since: 1.11.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
type ColumnPredicate = (
```

`RowPredicate` turned on its side: the column's cells, its one-based position and — when a header column was named — the column keyed by the row names. Returning `true` selects the column.

## Examples

### Shape

```javascript
const predicate = (values) => values.every((cell) => cell === "");
```
